product_one_liner.value: Funnel is a marketing data foundation that collects, stores, prepares, models, visualizes and shares marketing data for marketing and data teams.

employee_band.notes: The careers page states that Funnel has 300+ employees.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains multiple technical posts by engineering, data and product staff, including posts on data-platform architecture, semantic modeling and connector infrastructure.

model_provider.notes: The public materials identify integrations with external AI clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Codex and Cursor, but do not identify the underlying model provider used by Funnel's in-product AI.

last_funding.notes: The latest publicly announced financing is an $80 million debt facility; the latest disclosed equity/pre-IPO round was $66 million in 2021-10.

raised_18mo.notes: The $80 million debt facility was announced in January 2026, within the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists one opening, Product Engineer - AI Product Experience, and no SDR, BDR or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel announced the Funnel MCP Server in a post dated 2026-05-19, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ryan L. Ball's profile states that he became Funnel's Chief Revenue Officer in March 2026.
